Meow Gateway

The local AI gateway for your coding agents.

Download Get Started

The problem

Multiple providers, multiple agents, fragmented config.

Every coding agent needs its own provider configuration, model naming, API-key management, and sometimes an incompatible API format. Model switching is painful and you have little visibility into token and cost usage.

The solution

One OpenAI-compatible local endpoint.

http://127.0.0.1:8317/v1

Features

Everything you need to connect providers, manage models, and expose one stable, local API to your agents.

Provider management

Add, remove, enable, and disable providers. Validate credentials and test connectivity, and support a custom endpoint where the provider permits it.

Secure credentials

Credentials are stored through the operating system keychain / deep credential store, never persisted in renderer state or exposed unnecessarily.

Virtual models

Map cumbersome provider model IDs to friendly, stable virtual model IDs. Switch the underlying model without touching your agent configuration.

Local OpenAI-compatible API

OpenAI-compatible endpoints for /v1/models and /v1/chat/completions with SSE streaming, served on localhost.

Observability

Track request count, input/output tokens, cached tokens, latency, and estimated cost so you can see exactly what each agent is spending.

Routing & fallback

Configure primary and fallback providers, retry policies, and model groups for resilient, capability-aware routing.

How it works

Your agent talks to Meow Gateway. Meow Gateway does all the hard work on your behalf.

Agent
→
Meow Gateway
→
Providers

Point your agent at http://127.0.0.1:8317/v1

Provider authenticationSecurely authenticates to each upstream provider.
Model selectionResolves virtual models to the right provider model.
Protocol translationNormalizes each provider's API to OpenAI-compatible shape.
RoutingRoutes requests to the selected or fallback provider.
StreamingStreams responses end-to-end from provider to agent.
RetriesRetries failed requests according to policy.
Usage trackingCounts requests, tokens, latency and cost.

Download & install

Get Meow Gateway running in a few commands.

Prerequisites: Node 20+ and pnpm (npm i -g pnpm).

pnpm install pnpm dev pnpm typecheck pnpm lint pnpm test
